what: A 42px frosted-glass blob (--kf-surface 40% · backdrop blur 20px · 24px corners) follows the cursor at .1 of the remaining distance per frame, and the accent-colored dot in the middle (20px clipped to a 1px-radius circle, doubled) follows at .14, so the dot leads slightly inside the blob. Over an expand spot (data-cursor-expand — video, showreel) the blob grows to 102px in .72s, the dot opens into an 8px ring window, and around it two staggered bands of ”Play” text (260px, ±24°, one turn in 12s) flow, leaving 16–24px empty in the middle

options.lerp: Lump follow-through (ratio of remaining distance per Frame), default .1
options.label: Band text at the unfold spot, default 「Play」
options.min: Not applied in windows narrower than this width (px), default 1024

note: The system cursor is left as is (as in the original, the blob follows over it). Nothing is attached on touch, with reduced-motion settings, or below 1024px.
